invented.quote: From September 1, 2027, everyone will work in the office on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
invented.why: The brief gives the start date as 'September 1' and never states the year 2027.

invented.quote: The four of you who live more than two hours from the office can keep working remotely until December 31, 2027, and will come in one day a week from January 2028.
invented.why: The brief only says they can work remotely 'until the end of next year' and come in once a week 'after that', without giving the years 2027 or 2028 (and if the policy starts in September 2027, ' the end of next year' would not be December 31, 2027).
